latest_user_authorization.scope: This campaign only; supersedes the previous prohibition on sleep after an unresolved blockage.

normal_completion.requirements: All expected validated closures, pushes and corrections verified in the correct IDB; native save returns true with correct path, timestamp and readback; no active worker or outstanding final validation.

unrecoverable_error_or_blocking_checkpoi.eligibility: Root establishes that an error or blocking checkpoint cannot be resolved autonomously within the authorized scope.
unrecoverable_error_or_blocking_checkpoi.campaign_writing: Confirm campaign writes have stopped without duplicating, continuing or interrupting an active campaign; record evidence and any uncertainty. If writing cessation cannot be confirmed, do not claim this branch is ready.
unrecoverable_error_or_blocking_checkpoi.worker_finals: Record exact session IDs and whether pending/read-only/final states are confirmed or unconfirmed; do not claim every worker has finished. Pending or unconfirmed read-only finals do not themselves prohibit this branch.

save.attempt: Best effort native IDA save only if still accessible and actual native input and IDB identity are confirmed.
save.record: Record actual return true/false or unavailable, path and available readback evidence; never assert save true without proof.

forbidden: promoting uncertain findings to complete all pushes

scope.trigger: Root receives the automatic runtime completion, checkpoint or error notification for this campaign only; do not contact or poll the active campaign.
scope.normal_completion_required: For branch A only: normal completion of the active scope, including recoveries, repairs and pilot; no active worker or outstanding final validation.
scope.technical_return_handling: Not normal completion, but may qualify for branch B if the blockage is not autonomously resolvable.
scope.normal_case: Let the campaign finish without interruption. Resolve locally correctable issues within scope normally; no sleep for trivial script syntax errors or intermediate checkpoints with autonomous work still feasible.
scope.expected_findings: Every actually validated closure or promotion announced in the campaign journal and registry, including its corrections; not arbitrary drafts or uncertain findings.

root_verification_after_notification.applies_to: normal_completion; branch B uses its separate best-effort preservation and save requirements
comment_requirements: Appropriate unique tags and exact text or digests matching the validated findings and corrections; tag presence alone is insufficient.
Do not invent synchronization of a remaining inherited B comment.

failure_policy.result: Assess authorized branches: resolve autonomously within scope where possible; otherwise branch B may authorize sleep despite incomplete findings or unavailable/failed save, after confirming campaign writing stopped and recording exact state.
failure_policy.pending_work_handling: Feasible autonomous work continues normally; pending read-only finals are recorded accurately rather than treated as a universal no-sleep gate.
